তারিখ: ১৬ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৬ বঙ্গাব্দ/৩০ মে, ২০১৯ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ।

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act empowers the government to grant exemptions and modify existing customs notifications, which serves as the primary legal basis for this SRO.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act is invoked alongside customs laws to provide the necessary legal authority for the government to issue this SRO after consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
S.R.O. 158-AIN/2017/44/Customs: This existing customs notification is subject to further amendments regarding specific goods classifications and general conditions applicable to manufacturers and service providers.
TABLE: The table within the notification is amended to include new entries for specific goods such as Plaster/Cement products, various paints including fire retardant paint, and specialized mixtures like Fendolite MII.
Manufacturer: The conditions governing manufacturers are expanded to include service providers, ensuring that rules previously applicable only to industrial factories now extend to service-providing establishments.

Statutory Regulatory Order: This legal instrument is designated to come into force on the specified date in June of the year twenty nineteen.
